name: expiry-countdown
title: Expiry Countdown
description: ExpiryCountdown and useExpiry: the time left until a code or request expires in a role="timer", shown each second and announced politely once a minute and at 30, 20 and 10 seconds, with one timeout per second while the page is visible and none while it's hidden; useExpiry runs a callback once when the time passes.
docs: `<ExpiryCountdown expiresAt={epochMs} expiresIn={(_ms, time) => `Expires in ${time}`} />` shows `expiresIn(remainingMs, "m:ss")` (`h:mm:ss` past an hour) each second in a `role="timer"`, which isn't live, and announces it politely when it reaches a whole minute and at 30, 20 and 10 seconds, never on the first render. `useExpiry(expiresAt, onExpire)` returns whether the time has passed and runs `onExpire` once when it does, or on mount when it already has. Both keep one timeout at a time, none while the page is hidden, and check the clock when it shows again. `formatRemaining(seconds)` is the formatter. DeviceApproval and DeviceCodePrompt count down with it.
